venture_under_test.name: SentryOps
venture_under_test.description: SentryOps is a B2B SaaS Security Operations Center (SOC) platform combining SIEM + SOAR + threat-intel correlation, designed for security teams at companies with 500-5000 employees. We replace legacy Splunk / IBM QRadar deployments with an AI-first detection engine that auto-tunes correlation rules from your environment. Pricing is consumption-based at $0.40 per GB ingested + $80/seat/month for analyst access. Target buyer: CISO and Director of Security Operations. We compete with Splunk, IBM QRadar, Microsoft Sentinel, Palo Alto Cortex XSIAM, and SentinelOne Singularity. Differentiation: model-self-tunes against new attack patterns within 24h (no manual rule writing), pricing tied to outcomes (alert MTTR), and detection content built from CTI and MITRE ATT&CK rather than vendor signatures.
